title: Can you imagine a universe without a new 'Star Trek' on the horizon?
summary: As Star Trek celebrates its 60th birthday, the long-running franchise is also grappling with the challenges of timing and technology. "Its audience is aging," says Strange New Worlds star Anson Mount.
